HONG AI Edge Cage - bundled standalone runtime notices
======================================================

This notice covers standalone executables copied into native pilot and
bootstrap packages. JavaScript packages retain their own LICENSE files under
node_modules. Exact runtime versions are recorded in HONGAI-DELIVERY.json and
the build record shipped with each artifact.
